mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, order_no, pay_amount, refund_amount, net_pay_amount, product_cost, bonus_amount, company_share_amount, company_profit, risk_status, remark, create_time, update_time FROM dms_order_finance WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
